proof_body:
by
  intro a b h
  have key : ∀ z : ℤ, (z % 3 = 0 ∧ z ^ 2 % 3 = 0) ∨ (z % 3 ≠ 0 ∧ z ^ 2 % 3 = 1) := by
    intro z
    have hz : z % 3 = 0 ∨ z % 3 = 1 ∨ z % 3 = 2 := by omega
    rcases hz with hz | hz | hz
    · left
      exact ⟨hz, by simp [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, hz]⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨by omega, by simp [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, hz]⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨by omega, by simp [pow_two, Int.mul_emod, hz]⟩
  have ha := key a
  have hb := key b
  omega
